subject: maths
book: Mathematics, Open Basic Education Level A (English medium), NIOS, 2016 print

lessons.title: Reading, understanding, forming and writing numbers
covers: Read and write numbers from 1 to 1000 in digits and in words
Place value of ones, tens and hundreds
Find the smallest and greatest four-digit numbers
Put three-digit numbers in ascending and descending order

lessons.title: Addition and subtraction of numbers
covers: Add and subtract one-digit numbers
Add and subtract two- and three-digit numbers, with and without carrying or borrowing
Estimate sums and differences
Add and subtract rupees and paise in shopping and money situations

lessons.title: Multiplication
covers: Multiplication as repeated addition
Learn the tables from 1 to 10
Multiply one-digit by one-digit numbers
Multiply two- and three-digit numbers by one- and two-digit numbers (product under 1000)

lessons.title: Division
covers: Division as repeated subtraction
Divide two- and three-digit numbers by one-digit numbers
Share things equally in everyday situations

lessons.title: Fraction
covers: Idea of equal parts of a whole or a group
Read and write fractions with numerator and denominator
Halves, thirds and similar parts in daily life

lessons.title: Measurement
covers: Measure length in centimetres, metres and kilometres
Weigh things in grams and kilograms
Measure liquids in litres and millilitres
Choose the right unit for a measurement

lessons.title: Geometrical figures
covers: Square, rectangle and triangle on a flat surface
Solid shapes: cuboid, cube, cylinder, cone and sphere
Make designs with flat shapes
Draw and measure figures with pencil and ruler

gaps: The book has no module grouping; all seven lessons sit under one group.
Assessment sheets (after lessons 2 and 4 and after lesson 7) and the model question paper are not listed.
